exact_copy_template.headline: ROOM ABOVE TWO HUNDRED
exact_copy_template.deck: The week the pressure reached everyone
exact_copy_template.body: By Sunday night, the Commonwealth had learned that a number could become a weapon without anyone lifting a blade. Two teams had crossed two hundred. One sent a hamburger to a birthday party; another brought an army to a mountain gate. A centaur was chasing an outlaw through Highland mud. In the eastern ruins, a river quietly made a mockery of Red Leopards’ sandbags, while a second gust carried the same storm's reach to a court farther inland. Seven Deadly Chins found the one household that needed quiet and arrived with a jackhammer. Slob on my Dobb made a beer delivery through a swamp whose owner could no longer command the road. The front belonged to El Niño; the humiliations belonged to the men who chose them. With four regular-season games now remaining, the question was no longer simply who won. It was what each result would leave behind.

publication_copy.headline: One More Bag
publication_copy.deck: Red Leopards vs El Niño
publication_copy.body: The river did not arrive as a wall. It climbed a little, found a gap, and waited for Red Leopards to believe the last sandbag had solved it. The old goal leaned over a pitch still carrying last week's damage. Red Leopards shifted another bag into place. The water went around it. In 2022, he had beaten El Niño twice and carried thirteen wins into the semifinal. It was not the strength of the old season he remembered now, but how little of it had mattered on the night it ended.

publication_copy.headline: A Very Generous Guest
publication_copy.deck: Dr. Duckhook vs His Majesty's Blood
publication_copy.body: The dining hall in Jackson is full enough that the guests must turn sideways between the streamers and the cakes. Dr. Duckhook is the birthday boy, a host in his own kingdom of polished tables and familiar club service. His Majesty's Blood arrives beneath the storm-dark windows carrying an enormous present, belt visible and sword irrelevant. Last year Dr. Duckhook came within four tenths of stopping this rival's championship path. Tonight he opens the door to him.
